crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software Developers ground implementation, runtime and performance work but do not isolate audio DSP/device concerns.

crosswalks.label: Sound Engineering Technicians
crosswalks.rationale: Sound Engineering Technicians ground audio signal/routing/recording practice while authored/mixing/listening work remains distinct from software engineering.

findings.summary: Software Audio Engineering crosses software-runtime and audio-production practice, so generated/runtime evidence, listening evidence and authored audio judgment must remain distinct.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make generated audio, measured runtime/device behavior and human listening/artistic acceptance separate evidence and ownership surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Software Audio Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
